name: ruff
description: A Visual Studio Code extension with support for the Ruff linter and formatter for Python.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Virtual Workspaces are not supported by the Ruff extension.

scripts.check: npm run check:python && npm run fmt-check && npm run lint && npm run tsc
scripts.check:python: uv run --dev ruff check ./bundled/tool ./build ./scripts && uv run --dev ruff format --check ./bundled/tool ./build ./scripts && npm run check:release && uv run --dev ty check ./bundled/tool ./build
scripts.fmt:python: uv run --dev ruff check --fix ./bundled/tool ./build ./scripts && uv run --dev ruff format ./bundled/tool ./build ./scripts && uv tool run --with-requirements ./scripts/release.py ty check --fix ./scripts/release.py && uv run --dev ty check --fix ./bundled/tool ./build
scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile

ruff.nativeServer.markdownDescription: The extension always uses the native language server. This setting no longer has any effect.
ruff.nativeServer.markdownDeprecationMessage: **Deprecated**: Please remove this setting. The extension now always uses the native language server.
ruff.nativeServer.deprecationMessage: Deprecated: Please remove this setting. The extension now always uses the native language server.

ruff.configuration.markdownDescription: Configuration overrides for Ruff. See [the documentation](https://docs.astral.sh/ruff/editors/settings/#configuration) for more details.

oneOf.markdownDescription: Path to a `ruff.toml` or `pyproject.toml` file to use for configuration.
Inline JSON configuration for Ruff settings (e.g., `{ "line-length": 100 }`). *Added in Ruff 0.9.8.*

ruff.lint.preview.markdownDescription: Enable [preview mode](https://docs.astral.sh/ruff/settings/#lint_preview) for the linter; enables unstable rules and fixes.

ruff.lint.select.markdownDescription: Set rule codes to enable. Use `ALL` to enable all rules. See [the documentation](https://docs.astral.sh/ruff/settings/#lint_select) for more details.

ruff.lint.extendSelect.markdownDescription: Enable additional rule codes on top of existing configuration, instead of overriding it. Use `ALL` to enable all rules.

ruff.lint.ignore.markdownDescription: Set rule codes to disable. See [the documentation](https://docs.astral.sh/ruff/settings/#lint_ignore) for more details.

ruff.lint.enable.markdownDescription: Whether to enable linting. Set to `false` to use Ruff exclusively as a formatter.

ruff.format.backend.markdownDescription: The backend to use for formatting.

ruff.format.preview.markdownDescription: Enable [preview mode](https://docs.astral.sh/ruff/settings/#format_preview) for the formatter; enables unstable formatting.

ruff.path.markdownDescription: Path to a custom `ruff` executable, e.g., `["/path/to/ruff"]`.

ruff.importStrategy.markdownDescription: Strategy for loading the `ruff` executable. `fromEnvironment` picks up Ruff from the environment, falling back to the bundled version if needed. `useBundled` uses the version bundled with the extension.
enumDescriptions: Use `ruff` from environment, falling back to the bundled version if `ruff` is not found.
Always use the bundled version of `ruff`.

ruff.interpreter.markdownDescription: Path to a Python interpreter to use to find the `ruff` executable. Requires either the Python Environments or Python extension to be installed.

ruff.enable.markdownDescription: Whether to enable the Ruff extension.

ruff.organizeImports.markdownDescription: Whether to register Ruff as capable of handling `source.organizeImports` actions.

ruff.fixAll.markdownDescription: Whether to register Ruff as capable of handling `source.fixAll` actions.

ruff.codeAction.fixViolation.markdownDescription: Whether to display Quick Fix actions to autofix violations.

ruff.codeAction.disableRuleComment.markdownDescription: Whether to display Quick Fix actions to disable rules via `noqa` suppression comments.

ruff.showSyntaxErrors.markdownDescription: Whether to show syntax error diagnostics.

ruff.logLevel.markdownDescription: Controls the log level of the language server.

ruff.logFile.markdownDescription: Path to the log file for the language server.

ruff.trace.server.markdownDescription: Traces the communication between VS Code and the Ruff language server.

ruff.exclude.markdownDescription: Set paths for the linter and formatter to ignore. See [the documentation](https://docs.astral.sh/ruff/settings/#lint_exclude) for more details.

ruff.lineLength.markdownDescription: Set the [line length](https://docs.astral.sh/ruff/settings/#line-length) used by the formatter and linter. Must be greater than 0. Ruff 0.15.12 or older uses a maximum of 320.

enumDescriptions: The default strategy - configuration set in the editor takes priority over configuration set in `.toml` files.
An alternative strategy - configuration set in `.toml` files takes priority over configuration set in the editor.
An alternative strategy - configuration set in `.toml` files is ignored entirely.
ruff.configurationPreference.markdownDescription: The preferred method of resolving configuration in the editor with local configuration from `.toml` files.

ruff.enableExperimentalFormatter.markdownDescription: Controls whether Ruff registers as capable of code formatting.
ruff.enableExperimentalFormatter.markdownDeprecationMessage: **Deprecated**: Formatter capabilities are now always enabled.
ruff.enableExperimentalFormatter.deprecationMessage: Deprecated: Formatter capabilities are now always enabled.
